title: PartPilot CPU specification research worklist
purpose: Enumerate, classify, verify and research PC processor SKUs for the PartPilot hardware catalogue.

included: Intel and AMD x86 PC processor SKUs
legacy Intel and AMD PC processors
excludedForNow: microcontrollers and embedded controllers without PC CPU relevance
standalone compute accelerators that are not CPUs
scope.policy: Keep desktop, mobile, workstation and server product segments distinct. Do not infer specifications from family names or reuse another SKU's values. Mark ambiguous products for manual review.

schema.sourcePolicy: Prefer exact Intel ARK or AMD official processor specification pages and manufacturer briefs. Third-party CPU catalogues may be used for candidate discovery, never as sole confirmation for disputed specifications.

sourceCatalogs.name: Intel Product Specifications / ARK
sourceCatalogs.role: Primary Intel SKU specifications and compatibility fields

sourceCatalogs.name: AMD Processor Specifications
sourceCatalogs.role: Primary AMD SKU specifications, family, segment, clocks, cores, threads, cache, TDP, socket, memory and PCIe

sourceCatalogs.name: CPUVault Intel family index
sourceCatalogs.role: Secondary candidate discovery index; every candidate must be validated against Intel ARK

sourceCatalogs.name: CPUVault AMD family index
sourceCatalogs.role: Secondary candidate discovery index; every candidate must be validated against AMD official specifications

sourceCatalogs.name: AMD Desktop Ryzen portfolio
sourceCatalogs.role: Official desktop model/family discovery and published segment separation

sourceCatalogs.name: Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus launch
sourceCatalogs.role: Official validation of 270K Plus and 250K Plus 2026 desktop SKUs

sourceCatalogs.name: CPUVault complete brand/family index snapshot
sourceCatalogs.role: Secondary SKU discovery only; official Intel ARK and AMD spec pages are required for final verification.

inventorySummary.sourceCatalogSnapshotNote: The third-party discovery catalogue reports thousands of Intel and AMD desktop, mobile and server CPUs, but its index counts vary between pages/crawls. Counts are not treated as a definitive unique-SKU total; every family must be enumerated, deduplicated and checked against manufacturer catalogues.
inventorySummary.inventoryStatus: candidate inventory expanded but not exhaustive; requires further enumeration of all official Intel ARK and AMD CPU SKU entries, aliases and legacy parts
inventorySummary.note: Do not present candidate SKU counts as total possible CPUs until the official manufacturer catalogues have been fully traversed, deduplicated and reconciled.

secondaryDiscoverySnapshot.note: Third-party index counts at time of research; approximate discovery coverage only, not official vendor totals and not a claim that every listed product is verified. Embedded SoCs and microcontrollers are not included unless they are PC processors.

inventorySummary.skuEnumerationStatus: partial; family and architecture expansion ongoing, with desktop, mobile, server and legacy segments kept separate
